title_sq: Prane Kristal Center, Shitet Garsoniere Perfekte Per Banim Dhe Investim!!
description_sq: Prane Kristal Center, Shitet Garsoniere Perfekte Per Banim Dhe Investim!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 te nje pallati te ri dhe te pajisur me ashensor. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 35m² , nga ku 31 m² eshte siperfaqe neto dhe 4 m² siperfaqe e perbashket dhe organizohet nga nje ambient i rregullt ndenje me kend gatimi me dalje ne ballkon dhe nje tualet. Apartamenti eshte investuar totalisht duke filluar nga instalimet elektrike, hidraulike, parket, dyer-dritare, tualeti i ri si dhe mobilimi cilesor i sapo vendosur. Orientimin e ka Jugu cka mundeson diell dhe drite natyrale gjate gjithe dites. Vendndodhja eshte vlera tjeter e shtuar e ketij apartamenti i cili ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara te Tiranes e cila ofron te gjitha facilitetet e mundshme per nje jetese sa me komode, gjithashtu dhe nje super opsion per investim duke konsideruar kerkesat e shumta per qira. Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: Near Kristal Center, perfect studio apartment for living and investment!!
description_en: Near Kristal Center, perfect studio apartment for living and investment!!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a new building equipped with an elevator. The apartment has a total area of ​​35 m², of which 31 m² is the net area and 4 m² is the common area and is organized by a regular living room with a kitchenette with access to the balcony and a toilet. The apartment has been fully invested, starting with the electrical, plumbing, parquet, doors and windows, new toilet, as well as newly installed quality furniture. The orientation is South, which enables sun and natural light throughout the day. The location is another added value of this apartment, which is located in one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana, which offers all the possible facilities for a comfortable life, as well as a super option for investment considering the many requests for rent. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
